notes.title: ODINFALL Patch 0.5.7 is Now on the Experimental Branch! | TWITCH INTEGRATION
notes.content:
Vikings, it’s time to test something special!

Patch 0.5.7 is now live on the Experimental Branch! 

This update brings new weapons, gameplay improvements, and a huge new feature: Twitch Integration!

Want your chat to shape your run? Then this one’s for you.
(Full patch notes below)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43865335/82624138a710f4f07f6e3f5e8431aa5fe6af0638.png
Twitch Integration - How It Works
Enabling Twitch Integration
[olist] Opt into the Experimental Branch (more info on this below).
 Select the "Twitch" option in the settings.
 Log into your Twitch account to connect it to your game.
 Hit play, start the stream and you're ready to go![/olist]
How It Works
When entering a new node, a Twitch poll will begin.
Poll A: Weapon vs Weapon (75% chance) 
Viewers vote on 2 weapons; winning weapon drops for the player.

Poll B: Enemy vs Run modifier (25% chance) 
Viewers vote on an enemy OR a new run modifier.
-> If an Enemy wins the poll, the winning enemy will spawn on Floor 3 in one of three forms (1x Legendary enemy, 6x Elite enemies, or 20x Normal enemies).
-> If a Modifier wins the poll, the winning modifier is enabled for the rest of the node.

Enemies also appear with Viewer names
Chance per enemy type
-> Normal: 1 in 300
-> Elite: 1 in 40
-> Legendary: 1 in 2

Viewers who are subbed to your channel have stronger stats and drop 2 chests when defeated (non-subs drop 1).
Finally, whenever a viewer is defeated in game there is a small in game notification as well as a chat announcement.

We’re eager to hear your feedback on this update! Join us on Discord or over in the Steam forums and tell us what you think and to share your ODINFALL streams!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43865335/32ca599f21f9f86421f6dc0172860457a3a51df9.png

How to Access the Experimental Branch
For more info on the Experimental Branch and how to access it, check out the full rundown here:
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2154240/view/512953841353752650?snr=1_5_9_
Experimental Patch 0.5.7 Notes
GENERAL
• Twitch implementation – Let the audience decide loot and enemies!
• The pause screen now shows your current location and total kills.
• New animations for boss deaths
• New animations for cryo chamber pickups.
• Infinite areas scaling has been adjusted: enemies now gain +5 HP per floor 
• For elite enemies this is doubled, and for legendary enemies this is quadrupled
WEAPONS
• NEW: Cluster Launcher
• NEW: Heavy Ballista

notes.title: Introducing the ODINFALL Experimental Branch & Patch 0.5.3!
notes.content:
Greetings, survivors!

We’re excited to introduce a new way for you to get an early look at upcoming changes - our Experimental Branch! This system will allow us to test new updates with the community before rolling them into the main game, helping us fine-tune balance, fix potential issues, and make ODINFALL the best it can be.

How the Experimental Branch Works
Once a week, we’ll launch an ODINFALL patch into the Experimental Branch. Based on how it performs, we’ll then incorporate it into the main branch later that week.

How to Access the Experimental Branch
[olist]
 Open the game and go to Settings
 Navigate to Extra and select Experimental Branch
 You’ll receive a pop-up asking you to confirm your choice
 Restart your game and allow any updates to install
 Relaunch, and you’re in!
[/olist]
Keep in mind that the Experimental Branch uses a separate save from the main game to prevent incompatibility issues. If you ever want to switch back, just return to the main branch - your original save will still be there waiting for you!

We’d love to hear your feedback on changes in the Experimental Branch, so be sure to share your thoughts with us on Discord or the Steam forums!

notes.title: ⚔️ ODINFALL – FAQ & Community Info ⚔️
notes.content:
Hey Vikings!

ODINFALL has officially launched into Early Access, and we’ve been blown away by your incredible support so far. Whether you’re rampaging as a Viking Moose or blasting enemies with outrageous weapons thank you for being part of the apocalypse with us!

We’ve gathered some of the most frequently asked questions about ODINFALL right here to help you dive in and make the most of your roguelite rampage. If you’ve got more questions, feel free to post them in the Steam discussions or join our Discord community!

⚔️ ODINFALL – FAQ ⚔️
Welcome to the apocalypse, Vikings! Here’s a quick roundup of the most frequently asked questions about ODINFALL.

🕒 How long will ODINFALL be in Early Access?
ODINFALL will be in Early Access for approximately 6 months, with regular content updates and improvements along the way.

🎯 Will there be achievements?
Yes! Achievements are coming in a future update. (before 1.0)

🗺️ What's coming during Early Access and beyond?
We’ll be adding lots of new content and improvements, including:
 • New characters & abilities
 • Additional enemies
 • More weapons, perks & modifiers
 • Polishing, balancing & performance updates

📅 Is there a roadmap?
Not currently, we are taking things one step at a time so while we may not create one, we will ensure to keep you all updated through our social channels! 

🎮 Does ODINFALL support controllers?
Yes! ODINFALL fully supports controllers.

🎮 Does ODINFALL support Steam Deck?
We currently are not steam deck verified, but it should work completely fine as we have full controller and 16:10 resolution support!

👥 Is there co-op or multiplayer?
To focus on delivering the best core gameplay experience, we had to place Online Co-Op on hold for now. We'll be reassessing what needs to be done to get the Co-Op mode into a releasable state, and will be talking about this more in the coming weeks.

🔁 Is there an infinite mode in ODINFALL?
Yes! After you defeat the Act Bosses for the second time and onwards, a special door will appear that leads to an infinite mode area with escalating difficulty. Good luck in there, warrior!

🛠️ What engine is ODINFALL made in?
ODINFALL is developed using Game Maker Studio 2.

💾 Will my progress carry over after Early Access?
YES! We will always avoid resetting anyone’s progression across updates.

🐛 How do I give feedback or report bugs?
Please reply to the pinned steam discussion thread! - https://steamcommunity.com/app/2154240/discussions/0/601898665208999808/

💻 What platforms is ODINFALL available on?
ODINFALL is currently available on PC via Steam.

🎮 Will ODINFALL come to consoles?
We’d love to bring ODINFALL to consoles in the future, but for now our focus is on the PC version.

📹 Can I stream or create content on ODINFALL?
Absolutely! We love seeing your content – stream it, make videos, and share clips! Tag us so we can see the chaos.

🎵Is there a soundtrack I can listen to?
Yes! You can listen to the ODINFALL soundtrack here - https://davidsteinmarck.bandcamp.com/album/odinfall-extended-original-game-soundtrack

Leave a Review – It Helps a Lot!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43865335/6a2d9e1b2d02e373c4c662d5b2d139714e49f358.png

If you’re enjoying ODINFALL, please consider leaving a Steam review. Your feedback means the world to us and helps immensely as a small indie team. It not only supports the game’s development but also helps other players discover the chaos!

Thank you so much for joining us on this wild, explosive, Viking-fueled adventure. We’ve got more mayhem coming your way soon — stay tuned!

– Ember Paw Games & Fireshine Games

notes.title: An Update on Co-op in ODINFALL's Early Access
notes.content:
Hey Vikings!

Huge thanks to everyone who took part in the recent Co-op Network Test. Your feedback was incredibly helpful and gave us some much-needed insight into the mode’s performance.
 
Unfortunately, we found that the co-op feature wasn’t as stable as we had initially thought. Our priority as a small indie team is to deliver a smooth and polished gaming experience for all our players. So we have made the difficult decision to launch into Early Access without the originally planned co-op mode. At this time it is best for us to concentrate our efforts on the single-player mode. 
 
We’re dedicated to making Odinfall the most awesome game it can be, and we’re so grateful for your ongoing support and understanding.
 
Odinfall is shaping up to be an action-packed, chaotic adventure, and we can’t wait to share more news about what’s coming next very, very soon!
 
Thanks again for being such an amazing community. If you have any questions please do let us know and we’ll do our best to answer.

- Ember Paw Games <3

notes.title: ⚡ ODINFALL HAS A BRAND-NEW LOOK! ⚡
notes.content:
Hey, Vikings!

Ragnarok might be the end, but for ODINFALL, it’s just the beginning! We’ve been hard at work refining the game, and today, we’re excited to unveil a brand-new visual overhaul! From enhanced character designs to polished environments, ODINFALL has never looked this good.

So, what’s changed? Let’s dive in!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43865335/36d4a1c04ca98c5d93e88d61427039a9aa93fdbf.gif

🔥 New & Improved Character Designs
Our badass roster of apocalypse survivors has leveled up! Each character now features enhanced details, sharper animations, and an even more distinct personality. Whether you're wielding oversized weaponry or rampaging as a Viking Moose, you'll look cooler than ever.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43865335/677e0ec1617de09aed2a25d82e03e5e1005c2a2d.gif

🌍 Environments That Pack a Punch
Destruction has never been this satisfying! We’ve upgraded our procedurally generated levels with improved lighting, richer details, and even more chaotic destruction. Expect bigger explosions, more reactive elements, and a world that truly feels alive (before you blow it up).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43865335/9922e1b1ef0f11b0218b0f50d3a5df4c56ec2dbb.gif

⚔️ Combat That Feels Even Better
It’s not just about looking good - it’s about feeling good. We’ve tweaked animations, improved VFX, and added extra punch to every attack, explosion, and robotic god takedown. Combat is now faster, smoother, and more satisfying than ever!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43865335/5f1be15739b209b3559a4380f1b86cd67f549a8b.gif

💥 More Mayhem, More Fun
With all these changes, ODINFALL is shaping up to be the most over-the-top, chaotic rogue-lite shooter yet. And we’re not done - there’s still more to come!
We can’t wait for you to dive into this new version, so let us know what you think! Drop your thoughts in the comments or join the conversation on Discord.

Wishlist ODINFALL now and get ready for the ultimate Viking apocalypse! ⚡
👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/2154240/Odinfall/

Loot boxes (not really!)
